architecture.mechanism: Fail-safe operation via reverting to passive mode after control failure ensures low power consumption and rapid response in dynamic systems.
architecture.intervention: Implement a passive bypass valve in the hydraulic power steering circuit that automatically closes the variable-pressure regulator when ambient temperature drops below 5°C and the vehicle is parked on an incline, allowing the system to rely on static fluid pressure rather than active electronic modulation.
architecture.expected_effect: The intermittent loss of steering assist will cease during cold, incline-parked conditions because the active control loop is disabled, preventing failures caused by viscosity-induced sensor drift or control instability.
architecture.falsification_test: Intermittent loss of steering assist will not occur if a manual passive-bypass switch is activated to disable the active pressure regulator during cold, incline-parked conditions.
